search_boundary: Two targeted official-source search groups and three primary-source reads covering named sodium-ion delivery, grid commissioning, customer acceptance and public field performance; not an exhaustive market census.

sources_checked.finding: The English news index exposed no post-27-October sodium-ion BESS commissioning or independent field-performance record.

The CATL page reports a five-year 3 GWh INTILION memorandum and says sodium and lithium routes will advance in parallel. The body does not attribute the full tranche to sodium-ion chemistry or establish a named commissioned sodium-ion site, customer acceptance result, operating record or independent performance evidence. This event is already captured in open draft PR 70 and is not duplicated today.
INTILION's press-release index did not expose a matching 27 October announcement or newer sodium-ion commissioning record.

provenance_note: Open draft PR 70 remains the append-only record for the 27 October CATL-INTILION item. This review does not duplicate, overwrite or treat that pending record as newly discovered today.
